concerns.text: T105's verification requires records 'conforming to contracts/experiment_log.schema.yaml', but that schema makes `consensus_gap_score` a required field, and scores are only computed later in T109 ('writing scores back into the logs'). As ordered, T105's verification condition is unachievable — either the schema must allow null scores pre-evaluation, or T105's verification must be scoped to fields available at run time.

T105/T106 mandate 'static records carry `injected_state: null`' and 'Static records set both to null', but the active contract declares `injected_state` as a required `type: string` with `additionalProperties: false` and no null allowed. The mandated output cannot validate against the schema the tasks claim conformance to; the task or the contract must change (e.g., use the string 'none' as the schema's own description suggests).

T112 validates `classifier_training_data.json` against `contracts/trajectory.schema.yaml`, but T103's training records (turn windows with `turn_text`/`label`/`confidence_score`) are not ConflictTrajectory objects and can never pass that schema. The 'schema_valid is true' gate is unachievable; pair training data with a turn-record schema or drop it from T112's scope.

Plan's source layout places scripts under `code/src/{data,models,experiments,analysis}/`, but every task references `code/data/generator.py`, `code/experiments/runner.py`, `code/analysis/*.py` with no `src/` level. An implementer following the plan's structure will fail the tasks' path-based verifications; state which layout is authoritative.

data-model.md specifies trajectories at `data/processed/filtered_trajectories.jsonl` and its referential-integrity constraint points there, but T101 writes `data/processed/trajectories.jsonl`. Reconcile the filename so the integrity constraint references a file a task actually produces.

T106 is too coarse for deterministic execution: it consolidates T024/T025/T026/T028/T045A/T047A (runner loop, classifier integration, prompt injection, retry logic, aggregation, seeding) into one task with one verification. Split so each sub-deliverable (retry integration, aggregation format, seed determinism) has its own verifiable check; the atomizer will otherwise have to guess the boundaries.

T103 derives labels 'SOLELY from trajectory metadata tags' while FR-002 says the classifier is 'trained on metadata tags' but infers 'from dialogue history', and plan.md says 'trained on dynamic text features'. The implementer cannot determine what the classifier's input features are (turn_text? metadata?); specify the feature vector explicitly so the training-pair format is deterministic.
